name: Patellar Tendinopathy
description: Jumper's knee; overuse tendinopathy of the patellar tendon.
mechanism: Repetitive high-load knee extension (jumping, running, deep squatting).

name: ACL Sprain/Tear
description: Partial or full tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
mechanism: Non-contact deceleration + rotation or contact trauma.

name: MCL Sprain
description: Strain/tear of the medial collateral ligament.

name: Meniscus Tear
description: Tear of the medial or lateral meniscus cartilage.
mechanism: Twisting on a planted foot, often under load.

name: IT Band Syndrome
description: Lateral knee pain from iliotibial band friction.
mechanism: Repetitive knee flexion with weak hip abductors (runners, cyclists).

name: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome
description: Anterior knee pain, often described as "runner's knee".
mechanism: Overuse plus quad imbalance, poor tracking, weak glutes.

name: Chondromalacia Patella
description: Softening / degeneration of cartilage under the kneecap.

name: Baker's Cyst
description: Fluid-filled cyst in the popliteal fossa, often secondary to intra-articular pathology.
typical_recovery: Resolves with treatment of underlying cause

name: Rotator Cuff Strain/Tear
description: Partial or full-thickness tear of one or more rotator cuff tendons.

name: Shoulder Impingement
description: Compression of subacromial structures during elevation.

name: Labral Tear (SLAP)
description: Superior labrum anterior-posterior tear.
mechanism: Repetitive overhead loading or acute traction injury.

name: AC Joint Sprain
description: Sprain of the acromioclavicular ligament.

name: Shoulder Dislocation/Subluxation
description: Humeral head displaced from the glenoid.

name: Frozen Shoulder
description: Adhesive capsulitis; progressive loss of ROM.
mechanism: Often idiopathic; risk rises with diabetes, immobilization.

name: Biceps Tendinopathy
description: Irritation of the long head of biceps tendon.

name: Lumbar Disc Herniation
description: Nucleus pulposus protrusion compressing neural structures.
mechanism: Flexion under load; heavy lifting with poor mechanics.

name: Lumbar Strain
description: Acute strain of lumbar paraspinals.

name: SI Joint Dysfunction
description: Sacroiliac joint pain from aberrant mechanics.

name: Spondylolysis
description: Stress fracture of the pars interarticularis.
mechanism: Repeated lumbar hyperextension (gymnasts, divers, cricket bowlers).

name: Thoracic Outlet Syndrome
description: Compression of neurovascular structures at the thoracic outlet.

name: Cervical Strain
description: Strain of cervical paraspinals.

name: Hip Flexor Strain
description: Strain of iliopsoas or rectus femoris.

name: Labral Tear (Hip)
description: Tear of the acetabular labrum.
mechanism: Repetitive hip flexion + rotation; often with FAI.

name: FAI (Femoroacetabular Impingement)
description: Bony cam or pincer morphology causing impingement.
mechanism: Structural + activity demands exceed joint tolerance.

name: Piriformis Syndrome
description: Sciatic nerve irritation by the piriformis.

name: Greater Trochanteric Bursitis
description: Lateral hip bursa inflammation.
mechanism: Weak glute med, lateral hip compression.

name: Adductor Strain
description: Strain of the adductor group.

name: Ankle Sprain (Lateral)
description: Sprain of lateral ligaments (ATFL/CFL).

name: Achilles Tendinopathy
description: Degenerative tendinopathy of the Achilles.

name: Plantar Fasciitis
description: Plantar fascia degenerative overuse.

name: Stress Fracture (Metatarsal)
description: Bone stress injury, typically 2nd-3rd metatarsal.

name: Posterior Tibial Tendinopathy
description: Posterior tibialis overuse.

name: Peroneal Tendinopathy
description: Peroneal tendon overuse.

name: Turf Toe
description: Sprain of the great toe MTP joint.

name: Tennis Elbow
description: Lateral epicondylitis; common extensor origin.

name: Golfer's Elbow
description: Medial epicondylitis; common flexor origin.

name: Wrist Sprain
description: Sprain of wrist ligaments.

name: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
description: Median nerve compression at the wrist.

name: Finger Pulley Injury
description: A2/A3/A4 annular pulley strain or rupture.
typical_recovery: 6-12 weeks grade I-II; 3-6 months grade III-IV

name: De Quervain's Tenosynovitis
description: Tenosynovitis of APL/EPB at the wrist.

name: UCL Sprain (Elbow)
description: Ulnar collateral ligament sprain.

name: Trigger Finger / Tenosynovitis
description: A1 pulley flexor tendon irritation causing catching.

name: Whiplash
description: Acute cervical soft tissue injury.

name: Stinger / Burner
description: Transient brachial plexus neuropraxia.
mechanism: Impact driving shoulder down and head away.

name: Hamstring Strain
description: Strain of one of the hamstring muscles.

name: Quad Strain
description: Strain of quadriceps, often rectus femoris.

name: Calf Strain (Gastrocnemius)
description: Strain of the gastrocnemius.

name: Calf Strain (Soleus)
description: Low-grade strain of soleus.

name: Groin Pull
description: Adductor muscle strain.

name: Pectoral Strain
description: Strain or tear of pectoralis major.

name: Oblique Strain
description: Strain of internal/external oblique.

name: Shin Splints (MTSS)
description: Medial tibial stress syndrome.

name: Compartment Syndrome (Chronic)
description: Exertional rise in compartment pressure.

name: Overtraining Syndrome
description: Systemic under-recovery with fatigue, mood changes, performance decline.
typical_recovery: Weeks to months of reduced load

name: Tibial Stress Fracture
description: Bone stress injury of the tibia.

name: Femoral Stress Fracture
description: Bone stress injury of the femur.
